title: Емфатичні конструкції
rule: Емфатичні (cleft) конструкції виділяють головну інформацію. It was X who/that...: It was Maria who found the bug. What-речення: What I need is more time. The thing is..., The reason ... is that... Час дієслова be у what-реченні узгоджується з часом дієслова в частині what.

items.prompt: ___ made me change my mind was the salary.
items.explanation: What-речення: What + дієслово + was/is + виділена частина.

items.prompt: It was Maria ___ found the memory leak.
items.explanation: Виділяємо людину: It was + ім'я + who.

items.prompt: It was in 2021 ___ I wrote my first API.
items.explanation: Виділяємо обставину часу: It was ... that.

items.prompt: What really helped me learn Python ___ pair programming.
items.explanation: What-речення в Past Simple завершується was.

items.prompt: It is the lack of tests ___ causes most incidents.
What I did ___ restart the server.
The reason I applied ___ I liked the team.
items.explanation: The reason ... was/is that — стандартна конструкція; was why і because тут зайві.

items.prompt: It was only when I read the logs ___ I understood the problem.
items.explanation: It was only when ... that — емфаза часу.

items.prompt: What surprised me ___ (be) how fast the app was.
It was Tom ___ suggested using Redis.
items.explanation: Виділяємо людину: It was Tom who/that.

items.prompt: What I like most about this job ___ (be) the flexibility.
The thing ___ (be) that nobody read the documentation.
items.explanation: The thing is that... — розмовний зачин для головної думки.

items.prompt: It was Anna what found the bug.
answers: It was Anna who found the bug.
It was Anna that found the bug.
items.explanation: Після It was + людина вживаємо who/that, не what.

items.prompt: What I need it is more time.
answers: What I need is more time.
items.explanation: Після what-речення зайве it не потрібне.

items.prompt: It was yesterday when I deployed the fix.
answers: It was yesterday that I deployed the fix.
items.explanation: В емфатичній конструкції використовуємо that, а не when.
